paper.title_en: Quasi-Normal Modes of Covariant Loop Quantum Black Holes
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the quasinormal modes (QNMs) and time-domain response of a massless, minimally coupled test scalar field on static, spherically symmetric covariant loop quantum black hole (cLQBH) backgrounds. Focusing on a phenomenological, Gaussian-localized holonomy profile, we obtain a localized deformation of the scalar effective potential containing both positive and negative parts. This provides a geometric realization of the bump effect, with the potential deformation and tortoise-coordinate mapping determined consistently by the same background. We characterize the deformation by its location, amplitude, and width, and study its effects using frequency-domain shooting and time-domain evolution, supplemented by matrix-pencil mode extraction and waveform reconstruction. The QNM spectrum exhibits spiral trajectories as the bump location varies, enhanced sensitivity of the overtones, and mode overtaking, whereby the branch continued from the first Schwarzschild overtone becomes longer-lived than the continued fundamental branch. Despite substantial spectral changes, the early response can remain close to its Schwarzschild counterpart, with more pronounced differences emerging later. To quantify this behavior, we introduce a local waveform-deviation time and compare it with a relative-amplitude faintness time, thereby defining an operational observation window. The deviation time depends nonmonotonically on the bump location, and suitable parameter choices allow appreciable departures to emerge before the adopted faintness threshold is reached. These results connect localized holonomy corrections with spectral sensitivity and waveform evolution, providing a basis for future gravitational-perturbation studies and assessments of gravitational-wave detectability.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文研究协变圈量子黑洞背景下的准正规模与波形演化，提出局域完整修正对谱和可观测窗口的定量影响，主题与基础引力及扰动理论相关，方法结合频域与时域分析，具有继续阅读价值。
decision.title_zh: 协变圈量子黑洞的准正规模
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了静态球对称协变圈量子黑洞（cLQBH）背景上一个无质量、最小耦合试探标量场的准正规模（QNMs）和时域响应。聚焦于一个现象学的、高斯局域化的完整（holonomy）剖面，我们得到了标量有效势的一个局域化形变，其中同时包含正部和负部。这为凸起效应提供了一种几何实现，其中势的形变与乌龟坐标映射由同一背景一致地确定。我们用其位置、振幅和宽度来刻画该形变，并使用频域打靶法和时域演化来研究其效应，辅以矩阵束模式提取和波形重构。随着凸起位置的变化，QNM 谱表现出螺旋轨迹、高阶模的增强敏感性以及模式反超，即从第一 Schwarzschild 高阶模延续而来的分支变得比延续的基频分支更长寿。尽管谱发生了显著变化，早期响应仍可能接近其 Schwarzschild 对应物，更明显的差异出现在较晚阶段。为量化这一行为，我们引入一个局域波形偏离时间，并将其与相对振幅微弱化时间相比较，从而定义一个操作性的观测窗口。该偏离时间非单调地依赖于凸起位置，且合适的参数选择允许在达到所采用的微弱化阈值之前出现可观的偏离。这些结果将局域完整修正与谱敏感性和波形演化联系起来，为未来的引力扰动研究和引力波可探测性评估提供了基础。
